**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is considering getting a shoe organizer for their closet.

[EVENT] User's new dance shoes have been a game-changer for their Tuesday dance classes.  
[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of getting a shoe organizer with 12-15 slots.  
[FACT] User currently has 12 pairs of shoes left after donating and tossing some recently.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A shoe organizer can maximize closet space, provide easy access, protect shoes, and allow for customization.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should read reviews, check the return policy, measure closet space, and consider their budget before purchasing the shoe organizer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A 12-15 slot shoe organizer will provide ample space for the user's current collection and allow for future purchases.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consider the size of their shoes when planning storage, as larger shoes may require more space.  
[PREFERENCE] User plans to organize their shoes by type (e.g., heels together, flats together) and wants their dance shoes to be easily accessible.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested reserving 2-3 slots for dance shoes and grouping similar types of shoes together for organization.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended adding labels or signs to the slots for quick identification of shoe types.

[EVENT] User is thinking of getting a shoe cleaning kit to keep their shoes looking their best.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended looking for a shoe cleaning kit that covers multiple types of materials and includes gentle, non-toxic ingredients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested popular brands for shoe cleaning kits: Saphir, Kiwi, Jason Markk, and Crep Protect.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A cleaning kit can help remove scuff marks, condition the material, and prevent dirt buildup on dance shoes.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants a cleaning kit that covers multiple types of materials due to having a mix of shoes.  
[PREFERENCE] User is concerned about their dance shoes getting scuffed up easily and wants a safe cleaning kit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised to choose a cleaning kit specifically designed for dance shoes to avoid damaging glue or finish.

[PREFERENCE] User plans to get a cleaning kit specifically designed for dance shoes.
